questions.q: How many open jobs are there?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_jobs FROM jobs WHERE is_active AND is_duplicate_of IS NULL AND ghost_score <= 0.7 LIMIT 100

questions.q: How many remote jobs are open right now?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS remote_job_count FROM jobs WHERE is_active AND is_duplicate_of IS NULL AND ghost_score <= 0.7 AND remote LIMIT 100

questions.q: How many open jobs are in Bangalore?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_jobs_bangalore FROM jobs WHERE is_active AND is_duplicate_of IS NULL AND ghost_score <= 0.7 AND (location ILIKE '%bangalore%' OR location ILIKE '%bengaluru%') LIMIT 100

questions.q: How many open jobs does Databricks have?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_jobs_count FROM jobs AS j JOIN companies AS c ON j.company_id = c.id WHERE c.name ILIKE 'Databricks' AND j.is_active AND j.is_duplicate_of IS NULL AND j.ghost_score <= 0.7 LIMIT 100

questions.q: Which 5 companies have the most open jobs?
questions.sql: SELECT jobs.company AS company_name, COUNT(*) AS open_jobs FROM jobs WHERE is_active AND is_duplicate_of IS NULL AND ghost_score <= 0.7 GROUP BY jobs.company ORDER BY open_jobs DESC LIMIT 5

questions.q: How many open jobs were posted in the last 7 days?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_jobs_last_7_days FROM jobs WHERE is_active AND is_duplicate_of IS NULL AND ghost_score <= 0.7 AND posted_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' LIMIT 100

questions.q: How many remote Python jobs in Bangalore were posted this week?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS remote_python_jobs_bangalore_this_week FROM jobs WHERE is_active AND is_duplicate_of IS NULL AND ghost_score <= 0.7 AND remote = TRUE AND (location ILIKE '%bangalore%' OR location ILIKE '%bengaluru%') AND (title ILIKE '%python%' OR description ILIKE '%python%') AND posted_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' LIMIT 100

questions.q: How many open jobs mention Kubernetes in the title or description?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_kubernetes_jobs FROM jobs WHERE is_active AND is_duplicate_of IS NULL AND ghost_score <= 0.7 AND (title ILIKE '%kubernetes%' OR description ILIKE '%kubernetes%') LIMIT 100

questions.q: How many open jobs list a salary in USD?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_usd_jobs FROM jobs WHERE is_active AND is_duplicate_of IS NULL AND ghost_score <= 0.7 AND salary_currency = 'USD' AND salary_min IS NOT NULL LIMIT 100

questions.q: What is the average maximum salary of open jobs paid in USD, rounded to the nearest dollar?
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(salary_max)) AS average_max_salary_usd FROM jobs WHERE is_active AND is_duplicate_of IS NULL AND ghost_score <= 0.7 AND salary_currency = 'USD' LIMIT 100

questions.q: How many companies in the database are in the fintech industry?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS fintech_company_count FROM companies WHERE industry ILIKE 'fintech' LIMIT 100

questions.q: How many open jobs come from Lever?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_lever_jobs FROM jobs WHERE source = 'lever' AND is_active AND is_duplicate_of IS NULL AND ghost_score <= 0.7 LIMIT 100

questions.q: How many active jobs are marked as duplicates?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_duplicate_jobs FROM jobs WHERE is_active AND is_duplicate_of IS NOT NULL AND ghost_score <= 0.7 LIMIT 100

questions.q: How many active jobs are likely ghost jobs?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_ghost_jobs FROM jobs WHERE is_active AND is_duplicate_of IS NULL AND ghost_score > 0.7 LIMIT 100

questions.q: How many open machine learning engineer jobs are in India?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_ml_engineer_jobs_in_india FROM jobs WHERE is_active AND is_duplicate_of IS NULL AND ghost_score <= 0.7 AND (title ILIKE '%machine learning engineer%' OR description ILIKE '%machine learning engineer%') AND location ILIKE '%india%' LIMIT 100
